title: Fidelity Preference, Not Demographic Preference: A Pixel-Level Attribute-Sensitivity Audit of Image Aesthetic/Preference Scorers
abstract: arXiv:2608.23593v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-image systems use learned aesthetic scorers to filter training data and guide generation, but whether these scores encode demographic attributes as objective quality is unclear. We audit four scorers (LAION-Aesthetics, PickScore, ImageReward, HPSv2) using pixel-level interventions on skin tone and body type in synthetic and real images. Our key finding is that along skin-lightness, the dominant effect is fidelity preference: unaltered images score highest, and perturbations in either direction are penalized (inverted-U). Placebo arms show this penalty is not an artifact of the skin operator, as applying the same CIELAB L* shift to non-skin regions yields similar penalty magnitudes. However, the penalty is operator-dependent and holds for all operators only for LAION-Aes. translated_title: 保真度偏好，而非人口统计偏好：图像美学/偏好评分器的像素级属性敏感性审计
translated_abstract: 文本到图像系统使用学习到的美学评分器来过滤训练数据并指导生成过程，但这些评分是否将人口统计属性编码为客观质量尚不清楚。我们使用对合成和真实图像中肤色和体型的像素级干预，审计了四个评分器（LAION-Aesthetics、PickScore、ImageReward、HPSv2）。我们的关键发现是，在皮肤亮度方面，主导效应是保真度偏好：未修改的图像得分最高，而任一方向的扰动都会受到惩罚（倒U形）。安慰剂组显示这种惩罚并非皮肤操作的人为产物，因为将相同的CIELAB L*偏移应用于非皮肤区域会产生相似的惩罚幅度。然而，这种惩罚依赖于操作，并且仅对LAION-Aes在所有操作器中成立。关键的是，仅对合成图像的审计具有误导性：LAION-Aes对合成面部表现出对较暗皮肤的强烈偏好，但在1470张真实面孔上，p...
tldr: 本文通过像素级干预审计发现，图像美学评分器的主导效应是保真度偏好（原始图像得分最高，任何扰动都受罚），而非人口统计偏好，且仅依赖合成图像审计会产生误导性结论。
en_tdlr: This audit reveals that image aesthetic scorers exhibit fidelity preference (original images score highest, any perturbation is penalized) rather than demographic preference, and synthetic-only audits are misleading.
